case_study.heading: Featured Case Study — Luminary
case_study.body1: Luminary started as a weekend experiment: could a small editorial team replace their chaotic spreadsheet workflow with something that actually understood context? Twelve weeks later it became a production SaaS serving 400+ users.
case_study.body2: The core challenge was latency — AI suggestions had to feel instant or editors would ignore them. I solved this with streaming responses via the OpenAI SDK and an optimistic UI layer in Zustand that updates the calendar before the server confirms. The result is a sub-200 ms perceived response time even on slow connections.
case_study.body3: On the infrastructure side, I chose Prisma with a PostgreSQL read replica to keep dashboard queries fast as the dataset grew, and used Vercel Edge Middleware for auth so protected routes never hit the origin cold.
